heading: INT. SALT MINE ELEVATOR SHAFT - DEEP LEVEL - NIGHT

units.text: INT. SALT MINE ELEVATOR SHAFT - DEEP LEVEL - NIGHT
A cage of dented iron wedged halfway between two galleries.
Above, a ceiling of glittering rock salt, pink and white in the glow of a single miner's lamp.
The air is dry and tastes of old tears.
Somewhere far below, a pump shudders.
CALLISTA REYNOLDS-OKAFOR (30s, hair cropped, climbing gloves, a dusty duffel slung across her chest) crouches on the floor of the cage, a small drill whining in her hands.
On the opposite side, JONAH "SPARROW" PELLEGRINI (60s, wiry, a lifetime of tunnels written into his knees) sits with his back to the bars, a radio resting on his thigh.
The radio crackles.
Cage Four, Cage Four, this is surface. Do you copy?
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: Sparrow lifts the radio and looks at Callista.
She shakes her head, once.
Surface, Cage Four. We copy. Slight delay on the cable.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: Roger. We show you stopped at minus three hundred. Any injuries?
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: None. Cable guide's jammed. Giving it ten.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: Ten minutes, copy. Safety crew standing by.
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: Sparrow lowers the radio.
The drill falls silent.
Callista rests her palms on the floor, listening to the pump.
Ten minutes.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: Twelve, if I stall right.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: We need twenty.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: Then you shouldn't have asked for the cage.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: I asked for the cage because you said it stopped here every night.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: It does. For nine minutes. Then the night foreman rides the other one.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: You didn't tell me about the foreman.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: You didn't ask.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: She stands, shoulders the duffel.
Moves to the wall of the shaft, where a seam of white salt runs like a vein of frost.
She sets the drill against it.
The whine resumes.
A second voice, a woman's, cuts through the static.
Cage Four! Sparrow! What are you doing down there?
units.name: DISPATCH
paren: from far above, echoing down the shaft

units.text: Callista and Sparrow both go still.
The drill spins down.
Salt crystals tick onto the floor.
Cable jam, Yvonne! Nothing to see!
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: I'm coming down the ladder. Don't move!
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: Sparrow looks at Callista.
She looks at the duffel, then up the shaft, where a lamp has begun to swing.
Don't you dare call me a friend of yours.
units.name: CALLISTA

units.text: Wouldn't dream of it.
units.name: SPARROW

units.text: He sets the radio down, stands, and with a grunt drags the duffel to his side of the cage.
He sits on it.
Callista understands.
She steps out of the lamplight, into the pink shadow of the wall.
The lamp above steadies.
A boot appears on the rungs.
